## 1f9fef86a482

**Finding: reproduced distribution shortcut, medium severity.** A plausible wrong
solver can substitute bounding-box edge contact for actual cardinal cell contact
when constructing the component graph. It fits all three usable canonical pairs
and all 240 default scenes in the bounded independent census, yet fails on a
lawful scene accepted by the target's own validator. This is not a reproduced
generation-label error: the current sampler's labels agree with its intended
rule. It is a missing shape/contact witness in the sampled teaching domain.

Audited generator SHA-256:
`fa02b244487ff210c82c374b2274cb0226eedc0733315c8cbab6e4f837843496`.
Selected canonical Racket text SHA-256:
`dfe6e5f597b69f14162b8c7455f245ff237746b00abd827ee16dc2a48c626a28`
(rule pin `dfe6e5f597b6`). No audit-target or shared source was modified.

The sampled support is restricted to the fixed chain, star, and singleton-tree
groups (`generator.py:103–133`, selected at `332–347`), up to dihedral transforms
and translations. None of those layouts introduces a component whose bounding
box falsely touches another component at an empty corner. The validator instead
recognizes graph-degree and component-size signatures (`439–448`, `492–524`),
so it accepts additional embeddings in which this approximation is wrong.

The independent probe implements flood fill and both contact predicates without
calling generator-private or runtime-private helpers. The canonical-pair census
is 3/3 accepted by the validator, 3/3 matched by the exact-cell oracle, and 3/3
matched by the bbox rival. For each of easy, medium, and hard, 80 draws used
`seed=1200+sample_index`, `sample_index=0..79`, and no overrides. All 240 passed
the validator; bbox and exact-cell predictions agreed on all 240. These default
counts are Python diagnostic comparisons, not 240 new Racket executions.

The authored 9×12 counterexample uses two blue header cells, a blank separator,
and four distinct-color components of sizes 3, 4, 4, and 4. Its four-cell central
L has actual degree two. A separate four-cell component lies beside the central
L's empty bounding-box corner, introducing a false bbox edge. Actual component
degrees in reading order are `[0,1,2,1]`; bbox degrees are `[1,1,3,1]`. The bbox
rival consequently erases the entire answer. `self_check(input)==[]`, and
`observe_overrides` identifies a chain with a contiguous header. This is an
authored in-grammar scene, not claimed to be emitted for any seed/index/override.

Public `arcpuzzles apply` executed the unchanged canonical Racket authority on
`input.json`: output was valid, error was null, and it selected the four central
L cells. Its output equals the independent exact-cell expectation and differs
from `rival.json`. The receipt binds the audited generator hash and selected rule pin above. Its executable callable-text SHA-256 is `f0a8e857f39d1492b1cb4d74b4a5cb8a45649602d6334783130e979bd889762c`; this hashes the callable runtime wrapper rather than the raw canonical program text. Input SHA-256:
`0a863b8688f858c7fddad0a6941f20f4939a9c5a530f4789065ea0b9ca5cbb4c`.

Evidence: `checks/audit/1f9fef86a482/{probe.py,finding.json,input.json,rival.json,racket.json,commands.json}`.
`commands.json` records exact command argv, working directories, exits, and
evidence hashes. No full audit battery was run.

Recommended follow-up: add concave or holed multi-cell scene variants with
nearby components at empty bounding-box corners, retaining the intended exact
contact graph. Declare a bbox-contact rival and add a Racket-verified witness.
If three-demonstration deletion robustness is claimed for that new rival,
retain at least two effective witnesses in each four-pair lesson. Existing notes
already acknowledge finite morphologies and limited rival coverage; this audit
provides a concrete additional rival and an accepted-grammar counterexample.
